SourceEndpointAddressIP4 The IP address of the endpoint from which this activity originates.
Mutually exclusive with the SourceEndpointAddressIP6 field.
SourceEndpointAddressIP6 The IP address of the endpoint from which this activity originates.
Mutually exclusive with the SourceEndpointAddressIP4 field.
UalTotalAccesses
Count of accesses for the year (based on RoleGuid + AuthenticatedUserName + IP Address).
TargetFileName
The resulting file name that was downloaded
FfcFileIdentifier
24-byte concatenation of a filesystem volume's UUID and a file's inode value.
UalClientName
A GUID string for a tenant client of an installed role or product that accompanies the UAL data, if applicable.
UalServerProductName
The name of the software parent product, such as Windows, that is providing UAL data.
